visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black button-down shirt stands in a studio setting. He smiles warmly while gesturing toward a large rectangular cake decorated with gold leaf and a lit sparkler emitting bright white light. The background features colorful pink and teal studio lighting, wrapped gift boxes, and scattered confetti on the floor. Large white and pink text banners appear on the screen. (2) The scene cuts to a high-quality color photograph of Princess Diana. She is wearing a lilac-colored blazer and a pearl necklace, looking directly at the camera with a gentle smile. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese and a date overlay appear at the bottom center of the frame. (3) A black-and-white historical photograph of Giuseppe Garibaldi is shown. He has a full beard and wears a traditional striped shirt and a patterned cap. The background is a plain, neutral studio wall. Text overlays mention his name and date of birth in 1807. (4) A black-and-white archival photograph of John D. Rockefeller appears. He is an elderly man with a prominent white mustache, wearing a formal suit and vest. The shot is a medium close-up, focusing on his composed expression. (5) A classical painted portrait of John Calvin is displayed. He has a long dark beard and wears a black scholar's cap and a dark fur-lined garment. The lighting in the painting is dramatic, highlighting the contours of his face against a dark background. (6) A marble bust of Julius Caesar is shown from a frontal perspective. The sculpture depicts a stern facial expression with detailed hair and facial features. The lighting creates strong shadows, emphasizing the texture of the stone. (7) A professional studio portrait of Ma Ying-jeou is presented. He is wearing a dark suit, a white shirt, and a striped tie. He looks toward the camera with a slight, formal smile. The background is a clean, medium grey. (8) A traditional Chinese imperial painting of the Xianfeng Emperor is shown. He is seated on a yellow dragon throne, wearing ornate yellow robes with intricate patterns and a red imperial hat. The colors are vibrant with significant use of gold and red. (9) A close-up photograph of Nelson Mandela is displayed. He is an elderly man with short grey hair, looking slightly to the side with a calm and wise expression. He is wearing a dark suit and a light-colored tie. (10) A profile sketch of Francesco Petrarch appears. He is shown wearing a simple light-colored hood or cowl. The drawing style is minimalist, using fine lines to define his facial profile and the folds of his garment. (11) A black-and-white photograph of Goto Shinpei is shown. He has a short grey beard and mustache and wears round-rimmed glasses. He is dressed in a formal Western-style suit. (12) A black-and-white photograph of Benito Mussolini is shown. He is wearing a military cap with an eagle emblem and a high-collared uniform. He has a stern, intense gaze directed at the viewer. (13) The man from the first phase reappears in the studio. He points toward an on-screen graphic that looks like a camera recording interface with a red 'REC' light and the Taiwan Bar logo. He smiles and speaks directly to the camera, with scattered confetti still visible on the floor around him.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 歷史名人生日. [Subtitle]: 七月. [Logo]: Taiwan Bar. (2) [Subtitle]: 7月1日 黛安娜王妃. [Slogan]: 英國曾經最被紀念的王室成員. [Slogan]: 被譽為「人民的王妃」. (3) [Subtitle]: 7月4日 加里波底. [Slogan]: 義大利統一運動的軍事領袖. [Slogan]: 被譽為「義大利統一的寶劍」. (4) [Subtitle]: 7月8日 洛克斐勒. [Slogan]: 美國石油大王. [Slogan]: 歷史上第一位億萬富豪. [Slogan]: 他成立的洛克斐勒基金會更是今天所有慈善事業現代化的鼻祖. (5) [Subtitle]: 7月12日 喀爾文. [Slogan]: 16世紀歐洲宗教改革的領袖. [Slogan]: 創立了新教教派「喀爾文主義」. (6) [Subtitle]: 7月12日 凱撒. [Slogan]: 我來 我見 我征服. [Slogan]: 羅馬共和轉向帝國體制的關鍵人物. (7) [Subtitle]: 7月13日 馬英九. [Slogan]: 中華民國第 12 及 13 任總統. (8) [Subtitle]: 7月17日 咸豐皇帝. [Slogan]: 中國最後一位實際掌權的皇帝. [Slogan]: 任內有太平天國和英法聯軍. (9) [Subtitle]: 7月18日 曼德拉. [Slogan]: 長期推動反種族隔離運動. [Slogan]: 第一任南非總統. [Slogan]: 被廣泛認作南非的國父. (10) [Subtitle]: 7月20日 佩脫拉克. [Slogan]: 文藝復興時期的文壇三傑之一. [Slogan]: 被視為人文主義之父. (11) [Subtitle]: 7月24日 後藤新平. [Slogan]: 曾經擔任臺灣總督府民政長官. [Slogan]: 不知道的可以看看這支影片複習複習. [Slogan]: 第一支影片就談的人物. (12) [Subtitle]: 7月29日 墨索里尼. [Slogan]: 曾經擔任義大利首相. [Slogan]: 在義大利建立了法西斯主義的獨裁統治.
